title: Charts modeled on the sharp characteristic of a log regular scheme
statement: Let $(X,M,\alpha)$ be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\bar x$ be a geometric point above $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and put $P=\overline M_{\bar x}$. Then $P$ is a finitely generated integral saturated sharp monoid (sharp means that $0$ is its only invertible element), and there is a pointed etale neighbourhood $(W,\bar w)\to(X,\bar x)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-etale-morphism] with a chart $P\to M|_W$ whose induced map $P\to\overline M_{\bar w}$ is the chosen identification with $P$. The chart may be taken on an affine locally Noetherian $W$.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.6, printed p. 70: P is fs sharp and X admits a chart modeled on P at the geometric point (before the completed-local-ring formulas).

proof.text: Choose a pointed etale-local fs chart $Q\to M$ at $\bar x$ using the fs definition. Apply the face-localized chart lemma to this chart and its marked geometric stalk. With $F$ the inverse image of local units it identifies $M_{\bar x}$ with $Q_F\oplus_{F^{\rm gp}}A^\times$ and identifies the specified characteristic $P$ with $Q_F/F^{\rm gp}$, compatibly with the original chart. These canonical identifications fix which characteristic map the eventual chart must induce.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1 and 1.6, pp. 69--70; localized chart presentation.

proof.text: Apply face_sharpening to Q and F. Its canonical injective map from Associates(R), R=Q_F, to Q^gp/F^gp has the same representative formula as chartFaceQuotientCon. Hence that congruence is exactly equality of Associates classes, giving a canonical equivalence eA:(R/F^gp)≃Associates(R). Compose its inverse with the characteristic equivalence of step 1; transport finite generation, integrality and saturation along this monoid equivalence. Transport saturation using the induced equivalence of Grothendieck groups. The actual characteristic is sharp because it is Associates of the log stalk. Apply integral_monoid_free_sharpening_splitting to R, using the finite integer basis from face_sharpening. It gives j:Associates(R)→R, a section of the sharpening map, and an equivalence Associates(R)×Rˣ≃R with formula (b,u)↦j(b)u. The units inclusion Rˣ→Q^gp has image precisely F^gp: one inclusion is the units characterization, and the other follows because its subgroup image contains every face generator. Thus Rˣ≃F^gp. Together with eA this gives the required splitting (R/F^gp)×F^gp≃R and a section s with its specified representative formula.

Apply the conditional logification conclusion of chart_face_localization_logification to the section and product splitting of step 2. This gives the sharp stalk map ell∘s, the criterion that its structural image is a unit exactly at 1, a product equivalence with strict-local units, and the specified characteristic map. Precompose with the inverse of the canonical characteristic equivalence to obtain h from the actual characteristic monoid P. Check IsStalkChart directly: the product map h.coprod unitsIn is the product equivalence, hence bijective. Every generator of the divisorial chart congruence equates (p,1) with (1,a) where the structural image of p equals a unit; the unit criterion forces p=1 and then a=1. Thus the congruence and the kernel are both bottom. Fineness follows by forgetting saturation of the fs local charts. Apply exists_affine_chart_of_isStalkChart to h, using finite generation and integrality from step 2. Its germ equality and the characteristic identity from logification give Associates.mk(germ(β(p)))=p for every p.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1 and 3.7(a), pp. 69,75; prescribed-germ spreading.

proof.text: The obtained $W\to X$ is etale, hence locally of finite presentation. In the affine presentations defining this property, the finitely many polynomial variables generate the coordinate algebra, so the map is locally of finite type. Since $X$ is locally Noetherian, the locally-Noetherian finite-type lemma gives that $W$ is locally Noetherian. Together with step 2 and the affine chart of step 3 this is every clause of the statement.

proof_origin.place: Expose VI 1.1, 1.6 and 3.7(a), pp. 69,70,75; VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5, pp. 98--99. Lean assembly by J2 of the existing localized-logification, face-sharpening, integral splitting and prescribed-germ spreading declarations; quotient, unit, fine-saturation and stalk-chart conversions are proved private helpers.
